reason: I do not buy from someone who just shows up, I buy from whoever the guy at the supply house or my electrician cousin vouches for. Donovin at least admits a process fix might be the answer, but I have had no one in town tell me he has been through an HVAC shop like mine.
objection: Nobody I know has used him. An hour of my week is real money, and I have sat through free assessments before that turned into a pitch for software I did not need, that is exactly what Clockout sounds like.
would_change_my_mind: Two owners I actually know in the trade, one of them with a shop my size, telling me he walked their quote-and-schedule mess and it stuck without breaking anything. Then I would take the free look.
